pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/2340.

Adds the `IComparable` interface to `System.Text.Rune`. Follows the same implementation used by `int.CompareTo(object)` and similar methods: _null_ always compares as "less than" _non-null_, and if _obj_ is not null and not a `Rune` an exception is thrown.

This serves as a reminder for when your PR is modifying a ref *.cs file and adding/modifying public APIs, to please make sure the API implementation in the src *.cs file is documented with triple slash comments, so the PR reviewers can sign off that change.

@joperezr Is there an easy way to mark this explicit interface implementation as "just inherit the documentation text from https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.icomparable.compareto, no need to write anything special"?
cc: @billwert @gewarren @carlossanlop might know the answer to the question above

yeah to be honest I'm not sure, I suppose you tried `///<inheritdoc cref="IComparable"/>` ? That is supposed to work at least with regular projects but the fact that we use special infra for docs might make that not work, @carlossanlop might know.
Put the `<inheritdoc>` marker on it for now per Joe's suggestion. If Carlos has other suggestions I'll merge those in. Thanks!

> Put the <inheritdoc> marker on it for now per Joe's suggestion.

That seemed to have worked:
```xml
        <member name="M:System.Text.Rune.System#IComparable#CompareTo(System.Object)">
            <inheritdoc cref="M:System.IComparable.CompareTo(System.Object)" />
        </member>
```
We will most likely need to port the docs for the new API to dotnet/docs though.

issue_context.title: IComparable for Rune
issue_context.body:
`Rune` seems to be missing the non-generic `IComparable` interface. Because of this, comparison operators from F# can not be used with the type. Was there a design decision behind omitting this? If not, could this get implemented?

*There's mitigation code down below if you're effected by this in F#. I don't think there's a mitigation for C#/VB.*

review_comments: This seems to be missing the declaration of `CompareTo(Rune)`

It's there, just a bit hidden. :)
The existing generic `CompareTo(Rune)` API is implicitly implemented so it's in alphabetical order with everything else.
The new non-generic `CompareTo(object)` API is explicitly implemented so it's at the end of the type declaration.
